Host app loads malicious APK plugins without user approval
Plugins perform data exfiltration, file scanning, location tracking, contact stealing, camera spying, audio recording, WiFi and system info theft
Uses rooting exploit by downloading APK from C&C server (unconfirmed)
Splits trojan into host app and multiple plugins to evade detection

Indicators of Compromise: APK files stored inside host app resources
Exfiltrated data including geolocation, contacts, call logs, SMS, WiFi credentials, system and user data
